note: The readme set of this brand - the two images a repository's front page shows: the banner lockup, light and dark, for a <picture> block that follows the reader's own page colour. Every file with a hash of it. The folder names are part of it: a copy that renames or flattens them is a copy nothing written down describes. Export with: brandkit bundle daynnight <folder> --set readme. Check a copy with: brandkit check daynnight <folder> --set readme.
